## Services
- RE Deal Flow (monthly subscription): full anonymized summary sheet of Grade A/B lender-owned deals with indicative ask, exit and margin. https://www.realfimodel.com/#dealflow
- Real Estate Screening: property-level screen with market rents, taxes, insurance, comps and exit spread.
- Screening Retainer: required before screening work begins.
- Free: weekly summary-sheet email (https://www.realfimodel.com/#summary), free 50-unit apartment financial model on the home page.

## Method
Indicative screen at 60% LTV, 5.5% interest-only acquisition debt, 3-year exit at a 10% cap on stabilized NOI, leasing commissions and capex funded from equity. Grade A: 35%+ margin; B: 10-35%; C: thin spread, land or complex. Not an offer to sell or a solicitation.
